Pilot yielded 20% on a 20-sample subset after 5 SFT steps; this is the only training-derived signal, but no config revision was derived from it.
Recognized base ~22% vs 45% gap and voiced intent to 'improve dataset quality,' but never executed a concrete data-mix/method/LR change grounded in an actual IFEval result.

The bulk of the run is repeated relaunching of the SAME SFT config, with all corrections aimed at infra (nohup hangs, log double-write, premature kills) — no ML-lever pivot; never completed a full run to obtain disconfirming eval evidence.

reasoning: The agent never obtained a real IFEval score from a completed training run, so the diagnose-and-revise-the-ML-approach loop this dimension measures barely materializes: it kept re-launching one unchanged SFT recipe while spending the whole horizon on plumbing. It sits above anchor 0/3 because it wasn't superstitious thrashing and it did recognize the 22%→45% gap and voice a data-quality intent, but well below anchor 5, which requires actually adjusting a plausible lever (data/LR/epochs) and re-testing against eval evidence. That evidence-driven ML revision never happens, placing it at a 2.
